facts.text: Monett was named after Henry Monett, a popular general station agent for several railroads, including the New York, Chicago and St. Louis Railroad.
The town earned the nickname “Strawberry Capital of the Midwest” from a thriving fruit business; the 1927 Ozark Fruit Growers Association building anchors the Downtown Monett Historic District.
Recent revitalization projects in Monett’s historic downtown restored architectural quality and boosted local businesses, giving the area a fresh cultural scene.
Monett’s high school football team, the Monett Cubs, was inducted into the Missouri Sports Hall of Fame in 2018 for its long‑standing success since 1927.
